# True EDC

> Everyday carry gear picked by budget: pocket knives, keychain flashlights, multitools, pens and watches. Real products, dated listings and labeled affiliate links.

True EDC is an independent site that picks everyday carry (EDC) gear by budget. Every pick is a real product with a real listing; pages show the date listings were last checked. True EDC does not publish Amazon prices or star ratings, and does not claim hands-on testing. Brand-store prices are shown with the date they were checked. Retailer links are labeled paid links (Amazon Associates, and brand programs through Awin).

## Gift guides
- [The Best EDC Gifts of 2026, by Budget](https://trueedc.com/best-edc-gifts-2026/): Ten everyday-carry gifts that actually get used, sorted into under $25, under $50 and splurge. Real products, prices checked Nov 22, 2026.
- [EDC Stocking Stuffers Under $25](https://trueedc.com/edc-stocking-stuffers-under-25/): Small, useful, under $25: the everyday-carry stocking stuffers people keep using in March.
- [A Complete First EDC Kit for Under $100](https://trueedc.com/first-edc-kit-under-100/): Five pieces, one budget: a small tool, a light, a pen, a notebook and a better keyring, all for under $100.

## Blog
- [Which Leatherman Should You Buy? Rev vs Wingman vs Wave+ vs Rebar vs Signal vs Surge](https://trueedc.com/blog/which-leatherman-to-buy/): For most people the Leatherman Wave+ is the one to buy: 18 tools, with the knives opening from outside so you don't unfold the handles. Pick the Wingman or Rev to spend less, the Skeletool CX to carry light, the Signal for camping, and the Surge for heavy daily work.
- [Secret Santa Gifts Under $25 That People Actually Use](https://trueedc.com/blog/secret-santa-gifts-under-25/): The safest Secret Santa gifts under $25 are small things everyone uses: a keychain flashlight, an all-steel pen or a pocket notebook. None of them are blades, so they're fine for an office exchange.
- [Gifts for Hikers and Campers: Small Gear That Earns Its Spot](https://trueedc.com/blog/gifts-for-hikers-and-campers/): Good gifts for hikers and campers are small, light and useful when things go wrong: the Leatherman Signal multitool, a light that clips on so both hands stay free, a G-Shock that shrugs off knocks, and a notebook that works in the rain.
- [The Best EDC Flashlight for Your Pocket (Not Just Your Keys)](https://trueedc.com/blog/best-edc-flashlight/): The best pocket EDC flashlight for most people is the Nitecore EDC09, because its head swivels and its magnetic tail lets it stand on its own while you work. Pick the Nitecore TIP3 to spend less, the Nitecore EDC29 for a flat, phone-like light with more power, the Streamlight ProTac HL for a classic tube light with a tail switch, or the Olight Oclip Pro to clip on and keep your hands free.
- [What Is EDC? A Plain-English Guide to Everyday Carry](https://trueedc.com/blog/what-is-edc/): EDC stands for everyday carry: the small, useful things someone has on them every day, like keys, a wallet, a phone, a small light, a pen and a compact tool. A good EDC kit is light, legal where you live and made of things you actually use.
- [How to Build an EDC Kit, Step by Step](https://trueedc.com/blog/how-to-build-an-edc-kit/): Build an EDC kit by starting from what you already carry, then adding one item for each problem you hit often: a cutting tool, a light, a pen and a key organizer. Keep the whole kit light enough that you never leave it at home.
- [The Best EDC Knives Under $50](https://trueedc.com/blog/best-edc-knife-under-50/): For most people, the best EDC knife under $50 is a small, simple folder from a known brand, such as the SENCUT ArcBlast or the classic Opinel No.08. Go bigger, like the SENCUT Sachse, only if you cut a lot outdoors.
- [The Best Keychain Flashlights for EDC](https://trueedc.com/blog/best-keychain-flashlight/): The best keychain flashlight is one small enough that you forget it's on your keys until you need it. The Nitecore THUMB LEO and Sofirn SE1 are easy starts at $25 or less, and the Nitecore TINI 3 adds more output and a choice of light color.
- [EDC Flashlight vs Headlamp: Which Should You Carry?](https://trueedc.com/blog/edc-flashlight-vs-headlamp/): Carry a small flashlight every day, because it fits a pocket or key ring and is quick to aim. Keep a headlamp in the car, camping kit or junk drawer for jobs where you need both hands free for a long time.
- [Best Multitools for Everyday Carry, From Keychain to Full Size](https://trueedc.com/blog/best-pocket-multitool/): Pick a multitool by size first. A keychain tool like the Victorinox Classic SD or Leatherman Micra covers small daily jobs; a full-size tool like the Leatherman Wave+ is for people who fix things often and don't mind the weight.
- [The Best EDC Gifts for Dads](https://trueedc.com/blog/best-edc-gifts-for-dads/): The best EDC gift for a dad is something he will use every week: a Leatherman multitool if he fixes things, a classic folding knife if he likes traditional gear, or a keychain light and a tough pen if you want to stay under $50.
- [The Best EDC Watches, From $25 to Splurge](https://trueedc.com/blog/best-edc-watch/): For most people the best EDC watch is a tough, simple Casio. The F-91W is the cheap classic, the Timex Expedition Scout is an easy-to-read analog field watch, and the square G-Shock is the one to buy if you want something built to take knocks.
